'''Morrex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. He worked for the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group [[Rusher's Brigade]], serving as the comm station operator of the [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']], the group's [[Transport/Legends|transport]].
